resolution.description: Largest image size: the capture is scaled down to fit, never up; the result reports the scale.

tag.description: A label returned with the capture; default: its index in the sequence.

anyOf.description: Runs a command in the session. Synchronous by default: waits for the exit and returns the exit code and the output and error streams (each truncated to 64 KB). Use async for programs that keep running, e.g. GUI applications or a console to interact with: it starts the program as Explorer would and returns its process ID at once; with shell None the ID is the program's own.

args.description: Arguments, passed without shell parsing with shell None.

async.description: Start the program as Explorer would (console programs get a window, nothing is redirected) and return its process ID at once; Control.Join does not wait for it, Process.WaitForProcess does.

command.description: The command for the shell, or with shell None the path of an executable.

shell.description: PowerShell (default, Windows PowerShell), Pwsh (PowerShell 7), Cmd, or None (no shell parsing).

timeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for the exit, default 10000; when it expires the sequence stops with a Timeout error and the process keeps running.

anyOf.description: Asks a process to exit gracefully: its windows get a close request, console processes get Ctrl+C. Returns its exit code; use Process.Kill if it does not exit.

pid.description: The process ID, e.g. from Process.Run or Process.Enumerate.

timeout.description: Milliseconds to wait at most, default 10000; when it expires the sequence stops with a Timeout error.

anyOf.description: Terminates a process immediately, without a chance to save or clean up.

Reads the session's clipboard (separate from the user's). Always lists the formats on the clipboard; without format also returns the text, if any. Images are returned like captures. Raw data is limited to 1 MB.

format.description: Text, Html, Image, Files or Raw.

name.description: For Raw: a registered clipboard format name, a standard one such as CF_UNICODETEXT, or a format number.

output.description: For images: Inline (default), File or Both.

path.description: For images: the file path for File and Both.

resolution.description: For images: the largest image size.

anyOf.description: Replaces the session's clipboard content; offer several formats at once (e.g. Text and Html), as applications do.

data.description: text and html: a string; image and raw: base64; files: an array of paths.

name.description: raw: a registered clipboard format name, a standard one such as CF_UNICODETEXT, or a format number.

path.description: image: an image file (PNG, JPEG, BMP, ...) to put on the clipboard instead of data.
